ast.scope: Explicit gap: no syntax projection or semantic AST.

obernants.scope: U is valid fact/query/world-text to finite Scored transitions. R sums the five terms and returns diagnostic flags. U minus R includes +3 predicate when no first-Pred alternative matches and +3 subject when only another role matches. Malformed sent=0 is outside domain due to subtraction underflow behavior.

For score s, compatible antecedents are all feature assignments whose sum equals s, including role and section tradeoffs. Scored flags narrow but do not identify matched IDs or lexical alternatives; why text is not a full provenance trace.
Adding one matching q.others occurrence adds 1.5; adding a repeated q.words group adds its best field weight. Adding another matching predicate group changes nothing once pred=true.
Search result set equals keep-filtered facts, including negative-score facts; there is no score cutoff or top-k truncation. Order is descending score and ascending n, not anchor order.

For full Scored y, compatible tuples (fact,query,text) satisfy the joint constraints on n, total, pred, who, words, insec and why. Sum-only fibers are larger. Composition with section is an existential join on the same sent/text/secs/fut; independently choosing a compatible section and incompatible query is invalid. With fixed query, ignored fact neg/end/by/line and unmatched extra fields yield compatible full-Scored antecedents; this does not reconstruct an input world.

coverage.description: Score predicate, subject-role, other-ID, word and section features; filter facts before ranking by descending score then n.
